_comment: Display metadata for bridge tokens on MAINNET: what the UI shows for a
given tokenID. The testnet deployment reads tokenInfos.testnet.json; the file
is picked by the app.isMainnet setting.
This file is the source of truth - adding a token here is enough, no
frontend rebuild and no redeploy. Edits are picked up on the next request
(the file is re-read whenever its mtime changes), so no restart either.
"icon" is a key the frontend resolves to a bundled asset. Known keys:
apex, eth, polygon, sei, solana, unknown. An unknown key falls back to the
unknown icon, so a brand new asset can ship with "icon": "unknown" and an
optional "iconUrl" pointing at a hosted image until the asset is bundled.
"color" is the accent the UI paints the token in (legend dots, chart
series), as a hex string. Optional: a token without one falls back to the
unknownToken color, and to the UI's own default accent if that is unset too.
